scripts.db:init: docker compose exec backend npm run db:init
scripts.dev:local: concurrently -n "backend,frontend" -c "blue,green" "npm run dev --prefix backend" "npm run dev --prefix frontend"
scripts.test: npm test --prefix backend && npm test --prefix frontend
scripts.test:coverage: npm run test:coverage --prefix backend && npm run test:coverage --prefix frontend
scripts.sonar:coverage: npm run test:coverage && npm run sonar
